vm2 VM#run executes the string argument inside a sandbox marketed as safe; vm2 is deprecated precisely because its escapes proved unfixable (host RCE), so untrusted code reaching it is a sandbox-escape lead
vm2 NodeVM#run compiles and runs the source string in a sandbox with the same known-unfixable escape exposure as VM#run
new VMScript(code) compiles untrusted source for a vm2 sandbox whose isolation has known host-RCE escapes
isolated-vm Context#eval runs the string in a V8 isolate; a reach is a sandbox-escape lead where the isolate boundary is bridged or a leaked Reference is callable
synchronous form of isolated-vm Context#eval; same isolate-boundary exposure
isolated-vm Context#evalClosure runs a closure body string with bound references; a reach is a sandbox-escape lead when the bound references reach host capabilities
isolated-vm Isolate#compileScript compiles untrusted source that a later Script#run executes in the isolate
synchronous form of isolated-vm Isolate#compileScript
safe-eval evaluates the string via a vm context with a timeout; documented-unsafe with public host-escape payloads, so treat it as eval
static-eval evaluate() interprets an expression AST derived from untrusted input; crafted ASTs achieve RCE (known CVEs)
shell.exec() runs its string through a system shell; unsanitized input yields OS command injection (CWE-78).
execa.command(str) parses and runs a full command line; tainted input injects extra commands (CWE-78).
Synchronous full-command-string form of execa.command; same shell-metacharacter injection.
CoffeeScript.eval(src) compiles and executes source; tainted input runs arbitrary JS (CWE-95).
compile(src) then run executes attacker source; code injection via untrusted template/source.
Dynamic import() of a tainted specifier loads and runs an attacker-chosen module, eval-equivalent (CWE-95).
better-sqlite3 Database.prepare(sql) — concatenated user input in the SQL string is injectable (CWE-89).
Database.exec(sql) runs a raw multi-statement SQL string with no parameter binding.
sqlite3 Database.run(sql) executes a raw SQL string; concatenated input yields injection.
Database.all(sql) selects rows from a raw SQL string; tainted concatenation is injectable.
Database.get(sql) executes a raw SQL string; same string-concatenation injection class.
node-postgres Client.query(text) runs raw SQL; unparameterized concatenation is classic SQLi (CWE-89).
oracledb/mysql2 Connection.execute(sql) — the string form (no bind params) is injectable.
Collection.mapReduce runs a server-side JS map function / $where; tainted code runs in the DB (CWE-94/943).
distinct(field, query) — an object-valued query filter permits operator injection ($gt/$ne/$where).
countDocuments(filter) accepts attacker operators when the filter is built from request JSON.
Mongoose Model.find(filter) with a raw request object allows operator injection ($where/$gt) (CWE-943).
Model.findOne(filter) — same NoSQL operator-injection surface as find.
Model.updateOne(filter, ...) filter accepts injected operators selecting unintended documents.
Query.where() $where form evaluates server-side JS; CVE-2024-53900/CVE-2025-23061 abused nested $where.
Synchronous fs.openSync(path) — tainted path with ../ escapes the intended directory (CWE-22).
fs.mkdirSync(path) creates directories at an attacker-chosen traversed path.
fs.unlinkSync(path) deletes an arbitrary file when the path is tainted (arbitrary file delete).
fs.renameSync(old, new) — a tainted source/target path enables arbitrary file move.
fs.rmSync(path, {recursive}) removes an arbitrary path/tree under traversal.
fs.readdirSync(path) discloses directory listings outside the intended root.
fs.cp(src, dest) copies from/to an attacker-controlled traversed path (arbitrary read/write).
send(req, path) streams a file by path; unsanitized path serves files outside the root (CWE-22).
Deprecated res.sendfile(path) lacks the root-confinement of res.sendFile; tainted path traverses.
http.get(url) fetches an attacker-controlled URL, reaching internal hosts / cloud metadata (CWE-918).
https.get(url) — the .get sibling of https.request; same SSRF surface.
got.post(url) issues a server-side request to a tainted URL (SSRF).
request.post(url) — legacy request client, tainted URL enables SSRF.
superagent.post(url) issues a server-side request to a user-supplied URL.
needle.request(method, url) — url is the 2nd arg; tainted value drives SSRF.
XMLHttpRequest.open(method, url) — url (arg1) from an untrusted source enables request forgery.
new WebSocket(url) opens a connection to a tainted endpoint (SSRF / connection forgery).
res.set('Location', url) writes the redirect header raw; tainted value yields open redirect / header injection (CWE-601/113).
window.open(url) navigates to a tainted URL (open redirect; javascript: URLs also enable XSS).
setAttribute('href'/'src'/'srcdoc', v) with a tainted value injects javascript: URLs or markup (DOM XSS).
$.parseHTML(str) builds nodes from an HTML string; tainted input runs inline handlers (DOM XSS).
jQuery .insertAfter(html) injects markup adjacent to a node; unescaped input is XSS.
jQuery .insertBefore(html) — HTML-string sink like .before/.after.
jQuery .appendTo(target) with an HTML-string receiver injects markup (DOM XSS).
jQuery .prependTo(target) — HTML-string sibling of .prepend.
jQuery .replaceAll(target) replaces nodes with tainted HTML (DOM XSS).
res.send(body) reflects a body without HTML-escaping; tainted string is server-side reflected XSS.
res.write(chunk) streams an unescaped response chunk; reflected XSS when tainted.
$sce.trustAsResourceUrl bypasses AngularJS URL sanitization; tainted URL enables script/resource load.
Handlebars.precompile(src) compiles an untrusted template; RCE-class SSTI (cf. CVE-2021-23369).
ejs.compile(src) turns a tainted template into executable JS; SSTI to RCE.
pug.render(src) compiles+runs an untrusted template string; SSTI (pug <3.0.1 RCE).
pug.renderFile(path) with a tainted template path/source enables SSTI.
nunjucks.compile(src) compiles an untrusted template; server-side template injection.
Eta.compile(src) builds a function from a template string; tainted template is SSTI/code injection.
Hogan.compile(src) compiles an untrusted Mustache template; SSTI class.
funcster.deepDeserialize rebuilds functions from serialized data; untrusted input runs arbitrary code (CWE-502).
serialize-to-js.deserialize revives objects/functions from a string; RCE on untrusted input.
Cryo.parse reconstructs functions/closures from serialized data; deserialization to code execution.
js-yaml.loadAll with the legacy/DEFAULT_FULL schema instantiates arbitrary types from YAML (CWE-502).
node-expat Parser.parse feeds XML to expat, which resolves external entities, enabling file disclosure/SSRF (CWE-611).
xml2js Parser.parseString is XXE-prone when entity handling is enabled/mis-configured.
fast-xml-parser XMLParser.parse with processEntities:true expands external/DTD entities (XXE/billion-laughs).
String.matchAll(re) with a tainted/catastrophic pattern causes exponential backtracking DoS (CWE-1333).
crypto.createHmac('md5'/'sha1', ...) selects a broken hash; weak MAC/integrity (CWE-327/328).
crypto.pseudoRandomBytes is non-cryptographic; using its output for tokens/keys is predictable (CWE-338).
Marks arbitrary HTML as trusted, disabling Angular's contextual output encoding; untrusted arg rendered via [innerHTML] yields stored/DOM XSS (CWE-79).
Trusts a value as executable script, bypassing sanitization; tainted arg leads to script/code injection (CWE-95).
Trusts arbitrary CSS; attacker-controlled style enables CSS-injection/data-exfil and expression()-class XSS on legacy engines (CWE-79).
Trusts a URL, defeating the javascript:-scheme block; tainted href/src yields XSS/open-redirect (CWE-79).
Trusts a resource URL used for <script src>/<iframe src>; tainted value loads attacker code (CWE-79/CWE-829).
setProperty(el,'innerHTML',value) writes DOM properties with no sanitization; tainted value on an HTML-bearing property is XSS (CWE-79).
setAttribute applies attribute values unsanitized; tainted href/srcdoc/event-like attributes enable XSS (CWE-79).
Angular Router.navigateByUrl(userUrl) performs application-logic navigation; unvalidated URL/return-path yields open redirect (CWE-601).
Router.navigate(commands) with attacker-controlled command segments can redirect to unintended routes (CWE-601).
Angular HttpClient.get(url) with a tainted URL (esp. in SSR/proxy handlers) fetches attacker-chosen hosts, yielding SSRF (CWE-918).
HttpClient.post(url,body) first arg is the destination URL; tainted URL enables SSRF (CWE-918).
HttpClient.put(url,body) destination URL sink; tainted URL yields SSRF (CWE-918).
HttpClient.patch(url,body) destination URL sink; tainted URL yields SSRF (CWE-918).
HttpClient.delete(url) destination URL sink; tainted URL yields SSRF (CWE-918).
HttpClient.request(method,url,...) - the URL is Argument[1]; tainted value yields SSRF (CWE-918).
HttpClient.jsonp(url,cb) injects a <script src=url>; tainted URL is SSRF plus script-execution XSS (CWE-918/CWE-79).
TypeORM qb.where(string) interpolates raw SQL when a string (not :param) is passed; tainted string yields SQLi (CWE-89).
TypeORM qb.andWhere(string) raw-SQL condition; tainted arg yields SQLi (CWE-89).
TypeORM qb.orWhere(string) raw-SQL condition; tainted arg yields SQLi (CWE-89).
TypeORM qb.having(string) raw-SQL HAVING clause; tainted arg yields SQLi (CWE-89).
TypeORM qb.orderBy(string) column/direction is not parameterizable; tainted arg yields SQLi (CWE-89).
Sequelize.literal(str) injects its argument verbatim into generated SQL, bypassing replacements/binds; tainted arg yields SQLi (CWE-89).
Knex whereRaw(sql) emits raw SQL; string interpolation instead of ? bindings yields SQLi (CWE-89).
Knex havingRaw(sql) raw SQL; tainted arg yields SQLi (CWE-89).
Knex orderByRaw(sql) raw ORDER BY; tainted arg yields SQLi (CWE-89).
Knex fromRaw(sql) raw FROM clause; tainted arg yields SQLi (CWE-89).
Drizzle sql.raw(str) bypasses the parameterized sql`` tagged-template; tainted arg yields SQLi (CWE-89).
new Deno.Command(cmd, {args}) runs a subprocess outside the sandbox; tainted command path/args yields command injection (CWE-78).
Legacy Deno.run({cmd:[...]}) spawns a subprocess with --allow-run; tainted cmd array yields command injection (CWE-78).
Deno.readTextFile(path) - tainted path (and symlink components) escapes intended dir, yielding arbitrary file read (CWE-22).
Deno.readFile(path) arbitrary file read via tainted path (CWE-22).
Sync arbitrary file read via tainted path (CWE-22).
Sync arbitrary file read via tainted path (CWE-22).
Deno.writeTextFile(path,data) - tainted path yields arbitrary file write/overwrite (CWE-22).
Deno.writeFile(path,data) arbitrary file write via tainted path (CWE-22).
Deno.open(path,opts) opens an arbitrary file for read/write via tainted path (CWE-22).
Deno.remove(path) deletes an arbitrary path via tainted arg (CWE-22).
Deno.mkdir(path) creates dirs at a tainted path (CWE-22).
Deno.rename(old,new) - tainted source path traverses out of intended dir (CWE-22).
Deno.copyFile(from,to) - tainted source path yields arbitrary read (CWE-22).
Deno.stat(path) leaks file metadata for an arbitrary tainted path (CWE-22).
Deno.readDir(path) enumerates an arbitrary directory via tainted path (CWE-22).
CVE-2020-7637: plainToClass(Cls, plain) copies attacker keys incl. __proto__ from the plain object (Argument[1]) into instances, polluting Object.prototype (CWE-1321).
plainToInstance (renamed plainToClass) - same recursive copy of the untrusted plain object (Argument[1]) enables prototype pollution / unsafe deserialization (CWE-1321/CWE-502).
